title: 第610章 征伐九天冰释前嫌第609章 妖庭议事两大分歧
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
太一历经万古蛰伏、绝境证道、界体合一、重聚妖运，心中格局早已超脱一族之私，志在诸天至高、万古天帝。
太一声音低沉苍茫，带着定鼎纪元的无上决断：
“诸位所言，合道、合势、合天时。”
“昔日上古，朕与兄长帝俊君临九天、执掌天帝权柄，统御诸天万族，定乾坤、序阴阳、镇星辰、安洪荒。巫妖大劫，圣人布局、妖庭崩塌、帝位悬空，朕蛰伏万古，便是为重归正统、再掌诸天。”
“今洪荒大能尽去，天庭空虚、天道有机，正是朕重登天帝的最佳天时。”
“即日起，妖庭整军备战，兵锋直指九天天庭！”
“先破天庭、扫平诸天阻碍、重登至高天帝大位，复上古妖族掌天无上荣光！”
“待朕坐稳诸天正统、锚定洪荒帝权、气运圆满无缺，再回头规整妖族疆域、肃清割据叛逆、一统万妖道统！”
“精卫、玄朔，暂留其位、暂容其割据。待朕天帝权柄在手、大势压身，再清算巫族附庸、平定妖族全境！”
金乌帝音浩荡九天，响彻整座须弥妖庭，回荡西土洪荒，带着无可忤逆的皇者决断。
“谨遵妖皇天帝令！”
满堂妖神、两大妖尊、妖后常羲，尽数起身跪拜，山呼应命。
太一目光穿透殿顶穹苍，直视九天之上的巍巍天庭，眸光凛冽、战意滔天。
须弥妖庭的诏令，宛若一道撕裂万古长夜的无上法旨，自灵山之巅轰然降世。刹那间，亿万妖族肃然听令，那排山倒海般的威压，令整片洪荒大地的灵气都为之凝滞。
经过一番缜密而浩大的筹备，太一终是决意御驾亲征。
他身披暗金帝甲，眸若冷电，誓要扫荡那天庭，将上古妖族天帝的无上正统，重新镌刻于天地之间。
在他身后，十大上古妖神尽皆披坚执锐，煞气冲天，宛如十尊自远古复苏的魔神，紧随帝辇。
而在他们身后，是密密麻麻、望不到尽头的亿万妖庭大军。
大军整戈列队，兵戈如林，滔天的妖气汇聚成实质般的黑色怒涛，直冲九霄，将西土八荒彻底笼罩在一片令人窒息的恐怖阴影之下。
为确保此战万无一失，鲲鹏与接引两大妖尊悄然隐去身形，遁入虚空夹层之中，深藏幕后，以无上修为掠阵，将一切可能出现的突发变数扼杀于摇篮，更将那些企图趁乱插手、渔翁得利的暗中势力，尽数隔绝于战局之外。

妖后常羲则奉太一帝令，凤驾留守须弥灵山妖庭。她端坐于后方中枢，以无上母仪之姿，稳固着三色交融的庞大气运根基。
她不仅是妖庭的根本重地守护者，更是亿万妖族的人心定海神针，确保前线大军无后顾之忧。
一切调度皆已落定，浩荡妖军拔营而起，大军所过之处，虚空寸寸崩裂，化作混沌乱流。他们横渡无尽虚空，直指那至高无上的九天之上。
须臾之间，铺天盖地的妖兵便已兵临三十三重天界之外。
刹那间，金光漫天，却非祥瑞，而是杀伐之气凝聚的死亡光辉。无尽的妖云如墨色天幕，将整片九天疆域彻底覆盖。
上古凶煞之气如同实质般的山岳，狠狠压在每一寸天地之上，压得诸天星辰黯淡无光，九霄风云为之沉寂，仿佛连天道都在这一刻屏住了呼吸。
大军阵前，白泽一身素色神袍，不染纤尘，身姿卓然，宛如浊世中的一株孤松。
身为十大妖神之首，白泽缓步踏出阵中，眸光清冷，不带丝毫情感地俯瞰着那座巍峨却已显颓势的天庭天门，随后，他先礼后兵，那蕴含着无上修为的朗朗劝降之语，化作滚滚天音，传遍整座天庭的每一个角落：
“天庭诸位仙卿、诸天神将，且听吾一言！”
“上古纪元，我主帝俊、太一二位天帝，先后统御诸天，镇压星辰、安定乾坤、序定万族、安抚洪荒。
“他们执掌天庭正统权柄，乃是天道认可的三界至尊、万妖共主！然，昔日封神量劫倾覆，古妖庭崩塌，帝位悬空，天庭权柄旁落，秩序崩坏，至今已是万古有余！”
“如今，洪荒大势更迭，大能尽数远走，圣人遁迹虚空，天地格局再无制衡。我妖皇太一陛下，于万古沉寂中蛰伏，终得道果圆满，重聚妖族滔天气运，再立须弥新庭，此乃承上古之正统，合天道之时势！”
content_en:
Taiyi has gone through eternal hibernation, attained enlightenment in desperate situations, united worlds and bodies, and reunited with demons. His inner plan has long transcended the selfishness of one clan, and he aspires to be the supreme emperor of all heavens and the eternal emperor.
Taiyi's voice was deep and vast, carrying the supreme determination to determine the Ding Era:
"As you said, when it is in harmony with the Tao, in harmony with the potential, and in harmony with the sky."
"In the ancient times, I and my brother Di Jun came to the nine heavens, took charge of the power of the emperor of heaven, ruled the heavens and all the clans, established the universe, ordered the yin and yang, stabilized the stars, and pacified the great wilderness. The Lich Catastrophe, the layout of the saints, the collapse of the demon court, and the suspension of the emperor's throne. I have been dormant for eternity, in order to return to the orthodoxy and control the heavens again."
"Now that the great power of the prehistoric era is gone, the heaven is empty, and the heavenly way is organic, it is the best time for me to ascend to the throne of heaven again."
"From now on, the Demon Court prepares its troops for war, and the troops are directed towards the Nine Heavens!"
"First break through the heavens, clear away all the obstacles in the heavens, regain the throne of the supreme heavenly emperor, and restore the supreme glory of the ancient demon clan to the heavens!"
"When I have firmly established the orthodoxy of the heavens, anchored the prehistoric empire, and my luck is perfect, I will then go back to regulate the territory of the demon clan, eliminate the separatists and rebels, and unify all demons!"
"Jingwei and Xuan Shuo will temporarily keep their positions and allow them to separatist rule. When I, the Heavenly Emperor, have the power in my hands and the general situation is overwhelming, I will then liquidate the vassals of the Witch Clan and pacify the entire Monster Clan!"
The Golden Crow Emperor's voice was loud for nine days, resounding throughout the Sumeru Demon Court, echoing throughout the Western Land, carrying the irresistible emperor's decision.
"I will obey the order of the Demon Emperor!"
The hall was full of demon gods, the two great demon lords, and the demon queen Chang Xi. They all stood up and knelt down to worship, and the mountains responded to the order.
Taiyi's gaze penetrated the sky on the roof of the palace and looked directly at the towering heaven above the nine heavens, his eyes were piercing and his fighting spirit was overwhelming.
The edict of Xumi Demon Court was like a supreme decree that tore apart the eternal night, suddenly descending from the top of Lingshan Mountain. In an instant, hundreds of millions of monsters obeyed the order solemnly, and the overwhelming pressure froze the spiritual energy of the entire ancient land.
After some careful and extensive preparations, Taiyi finally decided to take charge of the expedition himself.
Wearing dark gold emperor armor, his eyes were as cold as lightning, and he vowed to sweep away the heaven and re-engrave the supreme orthodoxy of the ancient demon clan emperor between heaven and earth.
Behind him, the ten ancient demon gods were all armored and fierce, and their evil aura was soaring into the sky, just like ten demon gods resurrected from ancient times, following the emperor's chariot.
And behind them was a dense army of hundreds of millions of monsters with no end in sight.
The army lined up in formation, fighting like a forest, and the monstrous demonic energy gathered into a solid black raging wave, soaring straight into the sky, completely shrouding the Western Land and the Eight Wastes under a suffocating shadow of terror.
In order to ensure that this battle is foolproof, the two demon masters Kunpeng and Jieyin quietly disappeared, escaped into the void mezzanine, and hid behind the scenes. They used their supreme cultivation to plunder the formation, nip all possible sudden changes in the cradle, and isolate all the secret forces that tried to take advantage of the chaos to intervene and benefit from the battle.
The Demon Queen Chang Xi was ordered by Emperor Taiyi, and Feng Jia stayed behind to guard the Demon Court in Xumi Ling Mountain. She sits in the center of the back, with the posture of the supreme mother, stabilizing the huge foundation of luck that blends the three colors.
She is not only the fundamental guardian of the Demon Court, but also the anchor of the hearts of hundreds of millions of demon clan, ensuring that the frontline troops have no worries.
All arrangements have been finalized, and the mighty demon army rises up. Wherever the army passes, the void breaks apart and turns into chaos. They crossed the endless void and pointed directly at the supreme nine heavens.
In an instant, the overwhelming demon soldiers had arrived outside the thirty-third heaven.
In an instant, golden light filled the sky, but it was not auspicious, but the radiance of death condensed with killing energy. The endless demonic clouds were like an ink-colored sky, completely covering the entire Nine Heavens territory.
The evil energy of ancient times was like a substantial mountain, pressing hard on every inch of the sky and earth, making the stars in the sky dim and dull, and the sky was silent, as if even the heavens held their breath at this moment.
In front of the army formation, Bai Ze was dressed in a plain divine robe, not stained by dust, and his figure was outstanding, like a lonely pine in a troubled world.
As the leader of the ten demon gods, Bai ZehuanStepping out of the formation, his eyes were cold, and he looked down at the majestic but already declining gate of the heaven without any emotion. Then, he bowed first and then followed up with soldiers. His loud words of persuasion, which contained supreme cultivation, turned into the sound of heaven and spread throughout every corner of the heaven:
"All the immortals and generals in heaven, please listen to my words!"
"In ancient times, my lord, Emperor Jun, and Taiyi, two heavenly emperors, successively controlled the heavens, suppressed the stars, stabilized the universe, ordered all races, and pacified the great wilderness.
"They are in charge of the orthodox authority in heaven, and they are the supreme beings of the three realms and the co-lords of all demons recognized by heaven! However, in the past, the Conferred God Calamity was overthrown, the ancient demon court collapsed, the emperor's throne was vacant, the power of the heavenly court fell aside, and the order collapsed. It has been an eternity! "
“Today, the general trend of the ancient times has changed, all the great powers have gone far away, the saints have fled into the void, and there are no longer checks and balances in the pattern of heaven and earth. I, Your Majesty the Demon Emperor Taiyi, have been dormant in eternal silence, and finally achieved the perfection of Tao and Fruit, reunited the Demon Clan with their monstrous destiny, and established a new court in Xumi. This is the inheritance of the ancient orthodoxy and the current trend of the Heavenly Dao! "
